title: Yummy Jamaican Buchu Bowl
description: A sweet, pillowy bowl that blends Jamaican flavors with Asian chives and buchu. Perfect for a lazy Sunday treat.
instructions: In a saucepan, combine coconut milk, yogurt, maple syrup, vanilla, and a pinch of salt; bring to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low and whisk constantly until the mixture thickens slightly, about 5 minutes.
Stir in finely chopped Asian chives and buchu leaves until well distributed.
Transfer the custard to heat‑proof ramekins or small bowls.
Place the ramekins in a bain‑marie made with a larger pot of simmering water, covering the bottom of the ramekins.
Cook for 15 minutes, checking that the custard sets but remains tender.
Remove from heat, let cool slightly, then chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Serve each bowl topped with banana slices and a scatter of mixed berries.
